name: TikTok live mode readiness — /tiktok-status command
goal: Add /tiktok-status Telegram command (owner-only). Shows: TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN (set/missing), current SCS_MODE (mock/live), gate progress (posts/views), scs001-live PM2 entry present (check ecosystem.config.js string), steps to go live. Mirrors /stripe-status and /deploy-status pattern. Add to handleHelp() and index.ts routing.
rationale: Manual posting is the current default because TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN is blocked. /tiktok-status gives operator a Telegram-native checklist showing exactly what's needed to switch from manual to automated posting — essential information before the Apr 7 gate.
